what: A word in one slot of the sentence changes every 2.75s — the old word tilts to -8° and exits upward at -160% in .7s power2.in, the new word rises from below at 150% and 12° (bottom-left pivot) and straightens in 1.1s after a .58s delay, and the slot width grows or shrinks to the new word’s width over 1.2s. If a bar is present, the current slot fills over the tempo, and pressing a bar jumps to that word

options.step: Tempo for how long one word stays (s), default 2.75
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Words to rotate (kept hidden, two or more)
options.[data-fx-part=bar] · [data-fx-part=fill]: (If present) progress bar — if there is no fill inside the bar, the bar itself fills via --fx-fill

note: Use on single-line titles (if the cell wraps past one line, the width fitting breaks). The tempo keeps running off screen too — same as the original

from.where: index.html .rh-rotate [data-rotating-title] · index.js — original initRotatingText: step 2.75s, out .7 power2.in -160%·-8°, in 1.1 premium 150%·12° (delay .7-.12), width 1.2 premium, bar rAF
